title: A prompt parked after a transient bind failure waits for a manual resume, though it never reached the provider
outcome: A prompt whose admission was deferred only by a transient bind backoff, and which provably never reached the provider, is delivered automatically once the backoff ends, without anyone resuming the session.
acceptance: A test first establishes the inferred park: a session whose first bind fails transiently (for example, the authority acknowledgement exceeding its budget) has its first prompt parked in engram_waiting with auto-dispatch blocked. The test is recorded as failing before the fix.

After the fix, the same scenario delivers the prompt to the runtime once the bind backoff has elapsed, with no resume action and no new prompt. Prompts whose provider delivery is uncertain (the restart case of w-bf01dfb87ef4) stay fail-closed.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.
